votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of February 11, 2025, and March 25, 2025, and the formal meeting minutes of March 4, 2025, April 8, 2025, May 6, 2025, and May 20, 2025.
votes.description: The Council approved several prior meeting minutes from both work sessions and formal meetings held earlier in 2025.

votes.motion: Close public hearing and defer action on the Design Review Standards Amendment to a future council meeting.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on proposed amendments to Chapter 21A.59 of the Salt Lake City Code relating to Design Review standards and deferred any adoption decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close public hearing and adopt Ordinance 48 of 2025, Zoning Text Amendment - Parking Regulations in the Downtown Zoning Districts.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance amending parking regulations in the Downtown and Gateway zoning districts (D-1, D-2, D-3, D-4, and G-MU) of the Salt Lake City Code.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 49 of 2025, Text Amendment – Chapter 11.14 Parties, Gatherings, or Events.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted an ordinance amending Chapter 11.14 of the Salt Lake City Code to establish administrative fines for unruly parties, gatherings, or events on private property, replacing the prior police officer response service fee structure with a civil enforcement remedy.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 20 of 2025, extending the time to comply with the conditions in Ordinance 78 of 2023, Zoning Map Amendment 2157 South Lincoln Street, for an additional six months.
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution granting the property owner at approximately 2157 South Lincoln Street an additional six months to satisfy the conditions of the 2023 rezoning ordinance from RB to CSHBD2.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 21 of 2025, and approve the change to the Council Policy Manual regarding the Communication Budget section.
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution updating the Communication Budget section of the Council Policy Manual.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, including setting a public hearing date for August 19, 2025 on the Administrative Hearing Process ordinance and approving the appointment of Heidi Alder as a Disciplinary Appeals Hearing Officer.
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda, which set a public hearing date for an ordinance amending the administrative hearing process for civil violations and approved the appointment of Heidi Alder as a Disciplinary Appeals Hearing Officer through August 12, 2027.
